title: Ya Mustafa saws
body:
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya mustafa... swalle a'la..(2)
Mehboob e haqq, khairul bashar, islam ke baani nabi
shams uz zuha, badr ud duja, noor e khuda, shaan e wali
zakhmi hai dil, zakhmi jigar, ye jaanta hai kab koi
wo ghum mile hai aap ko sadqe me hai saara jahan
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaare nabi ya mustafa
har aankh hai girya kuna
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kya mustafa ne ghum sahe, duniya ko kab maloom hai
sab ke liye rehmat hai jo, khud kis qadar mazloom hai..(2)
qurbaan sab kuch kar diya
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Patthar use maare gaye jo rehmat e kaunain tha
taed ki galiyo me lahu
behta raha behta raha..(2) phir bhi nahi ki baddua
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ye sochte hai mustafa aaghosh mein shabbir hai
khanjar rawa gardan pe hai
zakhmi badan mein teer hai..(2)
aaegi ek din karbala
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Beti pe mere baad phir har zulm dhaya jaega
mohsin shahadat paega
ghar ko jalaya jaega..(2)
subbat ilayya ki sadaa
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hasnain hai girya kuna nana ki mayyat dekh kar
baba chale hai chodkar
zehra ka hai muztar jigar..(2)
ab kya karegi fatima
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haider ki aankhein ashk hai taboot mein hai mustafa
zehra akeli rehgayi aur puchti hai maamta..(2)
wo shaam kufa karbala
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Zainab ke lab par thi sadaa lut kar madine aagaye
kurta liya shabbir ka
marqad pe nana ki chale..(2)
mehshar bapa hone laga
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Lega wo badla zulm ka ek din 'Mohammad' akhri
uski musibat likh sake
haq hai ali safdar yahi..(2)
maine qamar nauha likha
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaare nabi ya mustafa har aankh hai girya kuna
<<MINI>>
Ya mustafa..(4)
